India's New Stock Market Closing Auction System Causes Price Swings

India's stock market has implemented a new closing auction system, leading to significant price swings and causing concern among traders. The system, designed to determine final stock prices, has been criticized for its volatility. The Hindu BusinessLine explained the mechanics of the new system and why it is causing these price fluctuations, noting that wild swings in the Sensex have worried traders. Bloomberg also reported on the issue, highlighting the "agonizing" experience for traders due to the new closing auction.
